newsitem.title: USA: Michaels Stores Nov same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Michaels Stores Nov same-store sales rise.

text.p: Michaels Stores Inc on Wednesday said its same-store sales in November increased by six percent from a year ago.
The November period encompasses the comparable five-week periods ending the Sunday after Thanksgiving in each year.

The company said that total sales for the fiscal month ended November 24, 1996, decreased by three percent to $152.4 million from $156.7 million last year due to the shift in the Thanksgiving holiday weekend to fiscal December this year from fiscal November last year.
Year-to-date through November 24, sales increased four percent to $1.04 billion from $994.9 million last year. Year-to-date same-store sales for the same time period decreased three percent.
